reply: {"assays":[{"name_in_paper":"experimental challenge with mosquito-borne falciparum malaria","quote":"Thirty-nine vaccine recipients were assessed at study entry; on the day of the third vaccination; at 24 h, 72 h, and 2 weeks after vaccination; and on day 5 after challenge.","obi_id":"OBI:0001982","obi_label":"protection from challenge in vivo intervention experiment"},{"name_in_paper":"malaria thick blood smears","quote":"Infection with malaria was determined by detection of parasite in malaria thick blood smears during the 30 days after challenge.","obi_id":"OBI:0003038","obi_label":"parasite detection assay"},{"name_in_paper":"GeneChip analysis","quote":"Preparation of cellular RNA and subsequent processing for GeneChip analysis were performed as described elsewhere [28], by use of the HG-U133 A 2.0 and HG-U133 Plus 2.0 GeneChips (Affymetrix) and the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer system (Agilent Technologies), to assess the integrity and quantity of RNA.","obi_id":"OBI:0001463","obi_label":"transcription profiling by array assay"},{"name_in_paper":"real-time polymerase chain reaction","quote":"To confirm observations from the gene chip data, TaqMan Gene Expression Assays (Applied Biosystems) were used to detect genes in the immunoproteosome pathway (PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and PSMA4) in 3 randomly chosen samples from protected and nonprotected persons, at 2 weeks after the third vaccination.","obi_id":"OBI:0000911","obi_label":"real time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction assay"},{"name_in_paper":"ex vivo CSP-specific IFN-g enzyme-linked immunospots","quote":"CSP-specific CD4+ T cells associated with interleukin (IL)-2, interferon (IFN)-g, tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-a, and CD40L; anti-CSP immunoglobulin (Ig) G levels; and ex vivo CSP-specific IFN-g enzyme-linked immunospots are observed in persons protected from malaria after challenge with infected mosquitoes [7, 12].","obi_id":"OBI:0600031","obi_label":"enzyme-linked immunospot assay"}]}
